headline.en: Review infographic changes one layer at a time.
headline.zh: 逐图层检查信息长图的变化。

sub.en: layerlong keeps an infographic as a structured LayerDoc and exports editable SVG and HTML alongside the JSON source.
sub.zh: layerlong 用结构化 LayerDoc 保存信息长图，并导出可编辑 SVG、HTML 与 JSON 源文件。

body.zh: 图片导出后仍保留 LayerDoc JSON。

body.en: Changes are tied to layer IDs and content.
body.zh: 变化对应图层 ID 与内容。

body.en: Use SVG and HTML from the same document.
body.zh: 同一文档可生成 SVG 与 HTML。

body.en: The bundled web preview highlights changed layers on re-render; PNG export always uses the clean SVG.
body.zh: 内置预览页再次渲染时高亮变化图层；PNG 导出始终使用干净 SVG。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Change the bundled sample growth value from 23.5 to 31.2, compute the layer diff and generate SVG in memory.
note.zh: 把随仓增长率从 23.5 改为 31.2，计算图层差异，并在内存中生成 SVG。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Parse the bundled synthetic infographic, change growth 23.5 to 31.2, compute semantic layer changes and produce SVG; no model extraction or incremental rendering benchmark.

body.en: Change the bundled sample growth value from 23.5 to 31.2, compute the layer diff and generate SVG in memory.
body.zh: 把随仓增长率从 23.5 改为 31.2，计算图层差异，并在内存中生成 SVG。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/layerlong.git
cd layerlong
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

title.en: See the diff loop in the preview
title.zh: 在预览页看 diff 闭环

steps.code:
layerlong serve
# open http://127.0.0.1:8000, change one stat value, render again

limitations.en: Coordinate-only layout changes are not counted as semantic changes; diff compares layer kind and data.
limitations.zh: 仅坐标变化不计为语义变化；diff 比较图层 kind 与 data。

limitations.en: The current CLI rewrites full outputs. A smaller changed-layer count is not evidence of incremental rendering speed.
limitations.zh: 当前 CLI 重写完整输出。较少的变化图层不代表已实现增量渲染加速。

limitations.en: The example uses deterministic parsing and does not exercise optional model extraction.
limitations.zh: 示例使用确定性解析，不验证可选模型抽取。

body.en: When a statistic changes, reviewing a flat image gives little indication of what moved. Stable layer IDs let you compare semantic content and keep the source for the next revision.
body.zh: 指标更新时，扁平图片难以指出具体改了哪里。稳定图层 ID 让你比较语义内容，并保留下一次修改所需的源文件。

body.en: Markdown and CSV parsers create LayerDoc objects. The renderer writes SVG and HTML for all layers. diff_docs pairs layers by ID and compares kind/data; a diff view highlights changed layers. The current CLI regenerates complete output files rather than caching only changed render work.
body.zh: Markdown 与 CSV 解析器生成 LayerDoc；渲染器为全部图层写出 SVG 和 HTML。diff_docs 按 ID 配对并比较 kind/data，差异视图高亮变化层。当前 CLI 会重新生成完整文件，并未缓存仅有变化的渲染工作。

body.en: Markdown and CSV parsers create LayerDoc objects. The renderer writes SVG and HTML for all layers. diff_docs pairs layers by ID and compares kind/data; a diff view highlights changed layers. The current CLI regenerates complete output files rather than caching only changed render work.
body.zh: Markdown 与 CSV 解析器生成 LayerDoc；渲染器为全部图层写出 SVG 和 HTML。diff_docs 按 ID 配对并比较 kind/data，差异视图高亮变化层。当前 CLI 会重新生成完整文件，并未缓存仅有变化的渲染工作。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: render accepts Markdown, CSV and LayerDoc JSON. --platform selects gzh or xhs, --out chooses the output directory, and --prev adds a diff HTML view. serve starts the local web preview, where re-rendering after an edit highlights the changed layers. extract defaults to mock; online extraction requires the selected provider configuration.
body.zh: render 接受 Markdown、CSV 与 LayerDoc JSON。--platform 选择 gzh 或 xhs，--out 指定输出目录，--prev 添加差异 HTML。serve 启动本地 Web 预览页，改一数据再渲染即高亮变化图层。extract 默认 mock；在线抽取需要对应提供方配置。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
layerlong render examples/sample.md -o out/
layerlong render data.csv -o out/ --platform xhs
layerlong diff previous.json current.json
layerlong extract text.txt -o out/ --model mock
layerlong serve
